title: Nonincised Papillae Surgical Approach (NIPSA) in Periodontal Regeneration: Preliminary Results of a Case Series. Moreno
authors: Rodriguez JA, Caffesse RG. Int J Periodontics Restorative Dent. 2018; 38(Suppl.):s105-s111.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Deep isolated intrabony defects can be successfully treated using the Nonincised Surgical Approach in conjunction with cerabone® and Emdogain®. It preserves the interdental papillae and marginal keratinized tissues avoiding post-operative soft tissue shrinkage” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
